The 'Recently decided' card for the undone suggestion has extra empty space below the 'Checked against 27 saved cases' row and no action buttons.
'Last runs' says '2 routing suggestions ready', but only one suggestion is waiting because the other was undone. This may confuse users but doesn't hurt the layout.
The 'Based on 3 corrections (0 with undo)' disclosure text is small and muted.
